question: Choose the correct one-word substitute for: 'A disease that spreads over a whole country or the world’.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pandemic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pandemic"** refers to a disease that spreads across multiple countries or continents, affecting a large number of people. (महामारी)

 
 
• **Example:** COVID-19 was declared a pandemic by the World Health Organization in March 2020 due to its widespread impact globally.
 

 
• **"Epidemic"** refers to a disease that affects a large number of individuals within a specific region or community. (महामारी)
 
 
• **Example:** The cholera epidemic in Haiti caused severe health crises in the region.
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct term for a disease affecting the whole country or the world is **'Pandemic'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pandemic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Epidemic** (महामारी): A disease affecting many individuals in a specific region or community at the same time.
 
 
• **Example:** There was an epidemic of dengue fever in the tropical region last year.
 
 

 
• **Endemic** (स्थानिक रोग): A disease or condition regularly found among particular people or in a certain area.
 
 
• **Example:** Malaria is endemic to certain parts of Africa.
 
 

 
• **Pathogen** (रोगजनक): A microorganism, such as a virus or bacterium, that causes disease.
 
 
• **Example:** The influenza virus is a pathogen responsible for causing the flu.
 
 

51:T6ff,

The correct answer is **option 2.**
